title: Junior Performance Marketing Executive
description:
BrightLeaf Digital is hiring a Junior Performance Marketing Executive to manage paid campaigns for D2C and SaaS clients.

Responsibilities:
- Plan, launch and optimise Google Ads (Search, Shopping, Performance Max) and Meta Ads campaigns
- Monitor daily spend, ROAS, CPA and CTR; recommend budget reallocations
- Set up conversion tracking using GA4, Google Tag Manager and UTM conventions
- Run A/B tests on creatives, audiences and landing pages
- Prepare weekly performance reports for clients

Requirements:
- 0-2 years of experience in paid media or digital marketing
- Hands-on knowledge of Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager and GA4
- Strong Excel / Google Sheets skills
- Analytical mindset and clear communication
- BBA / BBM / MBA in Marketing preferred

Nice to have: Google Ads and Meta Blueprint certifications, CRO experience, Looker Studio.

title: Backend Engineer (Python)
description:
Finlytics Technologies is looking for a Backend Engineer to build scalable APIs for our fintech analytics platform.

Responsibilities:
- Design, build and maintain REST APIs and microservices in Python (FastAPI / Django)
- Model and optimise PostgreSQL schemas and queries
- Build background workers and queues using Celery and Redis
- Write unit and integration tests; maintain CI/CD pipelines
- Deploy and monitor services on AWS (EC2, RDS, S3, Lambda)

Requirements:
- 2-4 years of backend development experience
- Strong Python, SQL and API design fundamentals
- Experience with Docker and Git workflows
- Understanding of authentication (OAuth2, JWT) and system design basics

Nice to have: Kubernetes, Kafka, GraphQL, Terraform.

title: Junior Digital Marketing Specialist
description:
Zalando is looking for a Junior Digital Marketing Specialist to support our performance and CRM teams in Berlin.

Your role:
- Support execution of paid search, paid social and display campaigns
- Manage campaign tracking with GA4, GTM and UTM parameters
- Analyse funnel data and report on KPIs (CPA, ROAS, conversion rate)
- Collaborate with creative and content teams on ad copy and landing pages
- Assist with email and push notification campaigns

What we expect:
- 1-2 years of experience in digital marketing, or a relevant internship
- Degree in Business, Marketing or a related field
- Solid knowledge of Google Ads, Meta Ads and GA4
- Fluent English; German is a plus
- Data-driven, structured and eager to learn

Nice to have: SEO basics, marketing automation (n8n, Zapier), SQL.

title: AI Engineer
description:
NeuralPath AI is hiring an AI Engineer to build LLM-powered products for enterprise customers.

Responsibilities:
- Design and ship LLM applications using OpenAI, Anthropic Claude and Gemini APIs
- Build RAG pipelines with vector databases (Pinecone, pgvector, Chroma)
- Develop agentic workflows and tool integrations using MCP, LangChain or LlamaIndex
- Evaluate model outputs, optimise prompts and reduce latency and cost
- Deploy inference services with FastAPI and Docker

Requirements:
- 2-5 years of software or ML engineering experience
- Strong Python skills
- Hands-on experience with RAG, embeddings and prompt engineering
- Familiarity with workflow automation tools such as n8n
- Good understanding of REST APIs and cloud deployment

Nice to have: Fine-tuning, LLM evaluation frameworks, Hugging Face, MLOps.

title: Full Stack Developer
description:
CartNest Commerce is looking for a Full Stack Developer to build features across our e-commerce platform.

Responsibilities:
- Develop responsive front-end interfaces with React, Next.js and Tailwind CSS
- Build backend services and REST APIs with Node.js and Express
- Work with MongoDB and PostgreSQL databases
- Integrate payment gateways (Razorpay, Stripe) and third-party APIs
- Participate in code reviews, sprint planning and QA

Requirements:
- 2-4 years of full stack development experience
- Strong JavaScript / TypeScript, React and Node.js skills
- Experience with Git, REST APIs and basic CI/CD
- Knowledge of web performance and SEO fundamentals

Nice to have: AWS, Docker, GA4 / GTM event tracking, Shopify.

title: Creative Media Specialist
description:
Pixelcraft Studios is hiring a Creative Media Specialist to produce high-performing ad creatives and social content for global brands.

Responsibilities:
- Design static, carousel and short-form video ad creatives for Meta, YouTube and LinkedIn
- Edit reels and short videos using Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects and CapCut
- Create brand assets in Photoshop, Illustrator and Canva
- Work with performance marketers to test creative variations and iterate on CTR and hook rate
- Use AI tools (Midjourney, Flux, Veo, Runway) to speed up concepting and production

Requirements:
- 1-3 years of experience in creative design or video editing
- Strong portfolio showing social and ad creatives
- Understanding of platform specs, storytelling and brand guidelines
- Ability to meet tight deadlines

Nice to have: Motion graphics, UGC-style content, basic knowledge of performance marketing metrics.
